title.narrative: Support to Iraq's electoral process

description.narrative: Contract related to: Support to Iraq's electoral process - This 18-month action will support efforts to organise transparent elections that respond to the legitimate aspirations of the Iraqi population. The capacity of IHEC will be strengthened inter alia through the deployment of additional electoral advisors who will help meet the ambitious calendar for the elections. IHEC efforts to adequately inform the public about the roles and responsibilities of all actors involved in the elections will also be strengthened.
